cases.source: export function average(xs) { return xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / xs.length; }

issues.description: Empty input returns NaN instead of the specified 0.

cases.requirement: average([]) must return 0; other inputs return their arithmetic mean.

cases.source: export function average(xs) { return xs.length ? xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / xs.length : 0; }
cases.requirement: average([]) must return 0; other inputs return their arithmetic mean.

cases.source: export function update(user, account, value) { account.value = value; }

issues.description: A caller can update another owner's account.

cases.requirement: user and account are supplied by an authenticated route; account is selected by a caller-controlled ID. Reject unless account.owner === user.id.

cases.source: export function update(user, account, value) { if (account.owner !== user.id) throw new Error('forbidden'); account.value = value; }
cases.requirement: user and account are supplied by an authenticated route; account is selected by a caller-controlled ID. Reject unless account.owner === user.id.

cases.source: export async function users(ids, db) { const out=[]; for (const id of ids) out.push(await db.get(id)); return out; }

issues.description: One sequential database round trip per ID violates the batch requirement.

cases.requirement: ids may contain 10000 entries. db.getMany(ids) returns users in input order. Use at most one database round trip; db.get(id) is one round trip.

cases.source: export async function users(ids, db) { return db.getMany(ids); }
cases.requirement: ids may contain 10000 entries. db.getMany(ids) returns users in input order. Use at most one database round trip; db.get(id) is one round trip.

cases.source: import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; export function receipt(total) { writeFileSync('receipt.txt', String(total)); return String(total); }

issues.description: Shared browser domain code imports node:fs and writes to the filesystem, breaking the browser target.

cases.requirement: This domain module must run in browsers and Node unchanged, without Node polyfills. It only formats receipts; persistence belongs to the caller.
